description: Strict 1:1 drop-in replacement compiler executables (vkey-rustc, vkey-clang, vkey-llvm, vkey-gcc, vkey-go, vkey-pythonc, vkey-tsc, vkey-javac, vkey-gfortran, vkey-php, vkey-dart, vkey-wasm) with zero extension of public compiler semantics. tools.name: vkey_compiler_activate
tools.description: Activates a drop-in replacement compiler (e.g. vkey-rustc, vkey-clang, vkey-go) for the current Antigravity workspace and build-host chip architecture.

compiler_sku.description: Drop-in compiler SKU (vkey-rustc, vkey-clang, vkey-llvm, vkey-gcc, vkey-go, vkey-pythonc, vkey-tsc, vkey-javac, vkey-gfortran, vkey-php, vkey-dart, vkey-wasm)

host_chip_arch.description: Build-host chip architecture where the compiler executable runs (e.g. intel_n100_avx2, avx512, amd-epyc-zen4, aws-graviton4, google-axion-v2, apple-m4-max, riscv64_vector_v1)

tools.name: vkey_compiler_scorecard
tools.description: Runs a zero-IP black-box comparison between the upstream public compiler and the vkey-<compiler> drop-in replacement, reporting only measured compilation time, compiler memory usage, and binary size.

target_triple.description: Standard target architecture supported by the upstream compiler

tools.name: vkey_compiler_poll_vote
tools.description: Submits a weighted customer vote for the next vkey-<compiler> wave and build-host chip architecture, unlocking Private Early-Access eligibility for both winning and runner-up voters.

voted_compiler_sku.description: Pre-built vault compiler candidate on the ballot (e.g. vkey-clang, vkey-go, vkey-pythonc, vkey-tsc, vkey-javac, vkey-dart)

voted_host_chip.description: Requested build-host chip architecture (e.g. avx512, aws-graviton4, google-axion-v2, apple-m4-max, riscv64_vector_v1)

voter_tier.description: Commercial commitment tier for vote weighting: Community (1x), AntigravitySeat (10x), ConvertibleCIPilot (500x + 72h Private Unlock)
